technical.summary: Short-term bullish setup with golden cross and volume spike, but overbought RSI(9), weak intermediate trend, and price below 200-SMA limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MAS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 92 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional selling (small amounts, recent dates) lacks conviction; no news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (435.2), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinationals, with earnings event 92 days out adding binary risk.
